home.heroSubtitle: A firm of excellence dedicated to international companies
home.home1: WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies since 1974.<nl/>Our firm is dedicated to assisting international companies,  small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defense of our clients before the courts and arbitral tribunals.<nl/>We think further, We work Smarter & We act Swiftly. <nl/> We represent & advise clients on a domestic and international level from corporate and commercial transactions including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, technology transfers, litigation & arbitration, White collar crime, employment and labor law, to corporate governance & law. Our team of about twenty people, focuses exclusively on your business needs to bring you excellent services & solutions in a more efficient & sustainable way.
home.home2: Our firm is a member of an international network of law firms sharing its culture of excellence and efficiency. Our lawyers are also admitted to practice before foreign bars, including Germany or the New York Bar in the United States. <nl/>In addition to French and English, the team also works in German, making the firm a high-level partner with expertise in cross-border business relations between France and Germany.

expertise.ourGoal: <bold>Our goal is very simple:</bold> To provide successful businesses, individuals and entrepreneurs with high-level tailored services to solve their problems. The law is constantly evolving, along with related developments in your industry and the larger economy, may affect you and your business. That’s why we are making a point to always go further work smarter and always act swiftly with your best interest in mind and greatest attention to detail.

expertiseList.title: Labor law and restructuring
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> has been supporting its clients since 1974 in the context of various social law issues, in advice and litigation.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We assist HR managers of multinational groups in complex and sensitive cross-border restructuring operations, in particular workforce reductions, site closures or company transfers.We intervene also in areas such as the integration of codes of good conduct and internal regulations, the negotiation of collective agreements on participation, profit-sharing or flexible working time, discrimination, termination of employment contracts and individual disputes or Our Firm Finally, for more than twenty years, has been advising the employer side in the context of the annual negotiation of a sectoral collective agreement.For any questions relating to subjects of interest in the field of labor law, you can contact our partners directly Mathilde WEIL and Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
expertiseList.intro: Our firm is regularly involved in Mergers & Acquisitions. We support our clients, whether French or foreign companies, in all phases of a transaction, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of strategies specific to each case, the conduct of negotiations through to the completion of the project.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We support our clients, French or foreign companies, in all phases of an operation, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of a strategy specific to each file, the conduct of negotiations until Our perfect command of German and English, in addition to French, allows us to advise our clients and draft all legal documents and contracts in these three languages.The multidisciplinary nature of the Firm allows us to quickly mobilize our various specialists, in order to quickly provide our clients with all the answers to the legal issues that may arise during an operation.Post-operation legal monitoring: Once the Merger operation has been completedSome recent significant examples:Acquisition for a Swiss group, one of the leaders in the sale of perfumes, cosmetic products and luxury products, of a French company specializing in the manufacturing and packaging of such productsAcquisitions for a German group of servicing and maintenance companies in the nuclear fieldAcquisitions for an American group of companies specializing in cloud computingBranch transfer of activity and goodwill in the pharmaceutical field.For any questions relating to subjects of interest in the areas of Mergers Patricia VINCENT and Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Corporate & Regulatory
expertiseList.intro: Our firm is renowned for both its advisory and litigation activities in corporate law matters.
expertiseList.paragraph1: From their incorporation to their deregistration, our team monitors the legal secretariat of all types of companies, commercial and civil, whether in the context of day-to-day operations (such as holding shareholder meetings, Weil currently manages the legal secretariat of around a hundred companies of all sizes, mainly belonging to international groups.Beyond advisory activity, our Firm assists and represents its clients in all contentious matters relating to corporate law (disputes between shareholders, with directors and corporate officers, liability actions, etc.).For any questions relating to matters relating to company law, you can contact our partner directly. Patricia VINCENT.

expertiseList.title: Litigation, mediation and international arbitration
expertiseList.intro: Whether it concerns classic litigation or complex procedures with strategic issues before state or arbitral courts, Weil
expertiseList.paragraph1: In this role, transparency towards the client is a determining element to avoid any unexpected or unforeseen results. The first step For us, it always consists of an in-depth analysis of the file in order to propose the strategy financially best suited to the challenges of each file, based on our assessment of the solidity of the file.With experience of internal and international litigation since 1974, our Firm is equipped with solid reflexes which allow it to appeal to lines of argument using the subtleties of the procedure, sometimes making it possible to put an end to a case without even having to address the merits In some cases more media, we have experience of using the media as an additional weapon in the management of the procedure.Finally, we never forget, and at all stages of the procedure, that our clients' business is not to litigate and that litigation always constitutes a source of internal nuisance.For any questions on topics related to litigation, mediation & international arbitration, you can directly contact our associate Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Insolvency proceedings
expertiseList.paragraph1: <square>The reactivity</square> and experience in insolvency law are key factors in the success of these operations.<nl/><square>Our Firm</square> is equipped with a <highlight>long experience</highlight> in these areas, allowing us to appreciate the most appropriate options offered by the law for companies in difficulty.

expertiseList.title: Commercial and Competition Law
expertiseList.intro: Our team has recognized expertise, thanks to its legal and economic training.
expertiseList.paragraph1: <bold>In particular, in terms of:</bold><nl/><square>commercial negotiating</square>, pricing transparency and restrictive practices<nl/><square>exclusive distribution</square> and selective distribution<nl/><square>consumer law</square>, advertisement<nl/><square>competition law</square>, cartels, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependence<nl/><square>legal procedures</square> common before civil and criminal courts<nl/><square>DGCCRF investigations</square> and procedures before the Competition Authority and community authorities.<nl/><nl/><bold>Some recent significant missions:</bold><nl/><square>assistance</square> of a leading company in the context of the analysis of anti-competitive practices in the postal market<nl/><square>assistance</square> and representation before the French and European courts of a manufacturer of consumer products<nl/><square>advice</square> for the development of a selective distribution network in the luxury sector, drafting of contracts and General Conditions of Sale<nl/><square>review</square> advertising campaigns and promotional operations for the marketing of electrical hand tools sold in DIY supermarkets<nl/><square>review</square> labeling of garbage bags and food films sold in general supermarkets<nl/><square>exam</square> range discount agreements for several major players in the pharmaceutical sector<nl/><square>elaboration</square> regulatory compliance programs for several players in the automotive sector<nl/><square>assistance</square> and representation of a leading pharmaceutical player in the context of the anti-gift law.

expertiseList.title: IP/IT, digital, tech and data law
expertiseList.intro: Our Firm constantly intervenes on behalf of our clients on matters relating to all aspects of intellectual property law and new technologies.
expertiseList.paragraph1: Here are some recent examples:General industrial property law: we support our clients during company sale or buyout operations, either by preparing the PI/IT part of the dataroom or by carrying out the legal audit during the due diligence phase; Copyright: we represent our clients in infringement proceedings before French courts, e.g. Patent law: we represent our clients during the preparatory phase (planning and execution of counterfeit seizures on French territory) and during counterfeiting and unfair competition trials before the French courts, for example on request. New technologies and IT law: we regularly intervene before courts or specialized arbitration courts for our clients in cases of domain name piracy, e.g. For any questions relating to subjects relating to the areas of intellectual property law and new technologies, please contact our partner directly Bruno WEIL who is responsible for these areas.

expertiseList.title: White collar crime
expertiseList.intro: Our firm has developed recognized expertise in the management of cases related to business criminal law.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We intervene upstream to advise our clients on the strategy to adopt when risky situations arise, for example for any offense linked to economic law or product regulation, or when offenses have been committed by employees or corporate officers. Knowing our clients' activities well, our lawyers are able to assist them effectively, particularly in terms of:Offenses “President fraud” type financial transactionsOffenses in the context of competition law, agreements, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependenceInvestigations of the DGCCRF and common law procedures before the criminal courtsCriminal Law workAbuse of corporate assets, breach of trust, passive and active corruption.For any questions relating to matters relating to business criminal law, you can contact our partner directly. Eric WEIL.

partenaire.teamPresentation: Our firm is made up of four experienced partners with <bold>over 100 years'combined professional experience</bold>. Each of them is fluent in English and German, and has an international legal profile and background. In addition to their specialist areas of expertise, each of our partners has a broad knowledge of business law, covering between them the full range of our clients'activities and needs.<nl/>You will find below an individual presentation of each partner. We also have a team of senior associates and lawyers, all of whom have legal training or international experience.

brunoWeil.title: Avocat (1999)
brunoWeil.name: Bruno WEIL
brunoWeil.intro: Active for twenty-five years as a lawyer for international companies of all sizes, present or active in France, Bruno Weil is your privileged contact within our firm for all questions relating to intellectual and industrial property, digital law, tech and data, as well as issues arising from the use of artificial intelligence. In this capacity, he acts as counsel and advocate before the courts in all types of contentious cases. In his capacity as counsel, he has successfully represented several US and German multinationals, both listed on the stock exchange and privately-owned, before the French courts, notably in complex patent, trademark and copyright infringement cases, as well as unfair competition litigation.<nl/>A former French correspondent for the publisher KLUWER LAW INTERNATIONAL, Bruno is also a member of several international associations dealing with intellectual property and new technologies, such as Licensing Executive Society - LES - Germany, GRUR and ITECHLAW. Bruno has published several articles on current topics in these fields.<nl/>Bruno Weil is also active in other areas of law, such as corporate restructuring and takeovers, product regulation and shareholder disputes. His day-to-day practice also involves all types of business-related advice and/or litigation. His main aim is to successfully devise the most effective business strategy to ensure that our clients' interests prevail.<nl/>In addition to French, Bruno is fluent in German and English.

ericWeil.title: Avocat (1996), Rechtsanwalt (1999), Attorney at Law (2002)
ericWeil.name: Eric WEIL
ericWeil.intro: Eric’s areas of practice are employment law, complex litigation, international arbitration, mergers and acquisitions and white-collar crime litigation.<nl/>Eric is highly recognized for his extensive experience in M&A, restructuring plan negotiations, multiparty employment litigation, complex commercial litigation of national and international importance. Having handled high-profiled, complex litigation matters on behalf of large global corporations, Eric offers quality and reactivity across a wide array of disputes. Eric’s comprehensive service, track record, tailor-made approach makes him a go to choose for companies faced with complex strategical issues. Eric also has extensive experience in white collar crime involving a wide variety of cases such as deceptive labeling of pharmaceutical products, misappropriation of trade secrets, forgery, misuse of corporate assets, hindrance to the rights of employees’ representatives or discrimination.<nl/>Eric also regularly advices and counsels his clients on sensitive internal fraud investigations. Eric’s top trial skills are also key for international arbitration: enhanced knowledge of international arbitration law and procedure, expertise across a broad range of industries and substantive areas of law and the ability to work fluently in English, French and German. The combination of skills, expertise, and experience, together with a multi-cultural approach, has enabled his team to obtain outstanding results for our clients.<nl/>Always bearing in mind his clients’ business objectives and economic goals, Eric is praised as a collaborative partner who offers high-level guidance in mergers and acquisitions, be it at a national level or cross-border. His background as both litigator and employment law specialist makes him a key player not only at the due diligence stage to spot potential risks, but more importantly at the negotiation level, when negotiating the specifics of the purchase agreement. When faced with the sensitive issues frequently surrounding employment matters, companies look to Eric for his experience in providing sophisticated and practical advice, including designing a negotiation strategy with worker’s representatives and Unions. Eric’s multidisciplinary approach enables him to offer creative advice taking into account all aspects of a given situation. Eric has dealt with the full spectrum of employment issues, such as large scale reductions in force, executive compensation, severance and employment agreements, restrictive covenants and trade secret litigation as well as issues arising from mergers, acquisitions, corporate restructuring and bankruptcies.<nl/>Over the past three decades, Eric has advised public and private companies in various sectors, including chemicals, automotive industry, luxury goods, pharmaceutical products, construction, banking sector, aviation and military weapons, tobacco industry, internet and new technologies, or logistics. Lastly, Eric takes a limited amount of bro bono criminal and domestic violence matters to assist and represent the victim in matters where the client is not speaking French and not in a financial position to hire a lawyer.<nl/>Eric is fully qualified to practice in France, Germany and the U.S.A. (state of New York) and has the ability not only to work fluently in all three languages but also to embrace, understand and weight all specific cultural aspects that make each case unique, and is therefore highly valued as lead counsel on complex cross-border issues.

patriciaVincent.title: Avocat (2005)
patriciaVincent.name: Patricia VINCENT
patriciaVincent.intro: Patricia is your primary contact for all matters dealing with corporate law. Together with our team, she advises and assists our clients, French or international corporate groups, in all legal matters, whether current operations (formation of companies, annual general meetings, appointment or dismissal of managers, directors and other corporate officers, etc….) or more complex matters and in particular restructuring of companies (mergers, spin outs, partial contribution of capital, restructuring of the share capital or liquidation of companies).<nl/>Patricia is also active in all M&A transactions, private equity, sales or purchases of companies or businesses. She has gained a strong experience in this field and is involved in all stages of the operation, from the legal due diligence, the strategic considerations based on the issues deriving out of each individual case, the conduct of the negotiations to the finalization of the agreements and finally the dealing with post transactional issues.<nl/>Her activities have brought her to finalize transactions for small and medium-sized corporations as well as multinational companies, whether in French, English or German, that she speaks and writes fluently.<nl/>Besides corporate law and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), she also dedicates a part of her activities to employment, commercial, insurance and social protection law, both in the field of counselling and litigation.<nl/>Patricia is member of several M&A and international bar associations.

mathildeHouetWeil.title: Avocat (1996), Attorney at Law (2002)
mathildeHouetWeil.name: Mathilde HOUET WEIL
mathildeHouetWeil.intro: After several years of practice with major international law firms, Mathilde Houet-Weil joined Weil & Associés in 2003 to lead and develop the firm’s labor and employment law department.<nl/>Mathilde has 27 years of experience representing English and German-speaking clients in a broad range of employment and labor-related litigation matters, both in counsel and litigation. She regularly counsels HR managers of global companies on their most important and sensitive labor and employment issues. She has extensive experience advising employers with respect to reorganizations (downsizing, closing of plants, business transfers, international and national mobility) as well as corporate policies, employment discrimination, whistleblower claims, breach of contract and wrongful termination claims, internal investigations, or mandatory working hours. Mathilde represents clients in labour courts, civil courts, criminal courts and administrative courts.<nl/>Mathilde’s clients come from all sectors of the global economy, including the automotive, pharmaceutical, chemical, mining, advertising, e-commerce, new technologies or luxury goods industries. Mathilde’s dual French-American education enables her to represent Anglo-Saxon companies in a global environment, thanks to a pragmatic approach focused on the economic stakes at hand and on solutions that fit into the social strategy of the company. Her excellent knowledge of the German language and German culture also leads her to successfully deal with French-German cross-border practice in Paris and New York. Mathilde is a recognized labour and employment law specialist and regularly speaks at conferences hosted by the American Bar Association, the International Bar Association and the Canadian Bar Association. Mathilde is the author or co-author of numerous publications, including “International Labor and Employment Laws” and “Social Networking”, published by the Labor and Employment Law Section of the American Bar Association.<nl/>Mathilde is fluent in French, English and German with some knowledge of Italian. Mathilde is recommended by her peers as:”an excellent lawyer, who is exceedingly well known and incredibly active in the market, particularly on an international level.” (Who’s Who Legal)<nl/>Mathilde regularly publishes articles in English for the American Bar Association on various topics related to labor law issues :<nl/><square>Gender</square> discrimination in France<nl/><square>Data</square> protection and privacy in the workplace<nl/><square>Edde Summer</square><nl/><square>Whistleblowing</square><nl/><square>2013 Social Media France</square><nl/><square>New law</square> eases redeployement obligations in France<nl/><square>French Workscouncils</square> and the reorganization of businesses<nl/><square>France social</square> networking and the Global Workforce<nl/><square>An Innangard Report</square> on Sexual Harassment in Key Jurisdictions (Chapter 'France')<nl/><square>Labor and Employment</square> Law newsletter winter 2019<nl/><square>Women and the Glass</square> Ceiling in France<nl/><square>Worker Misclassification:</square> An Innangard Report on Employee Status and Consequences of Worker Misclassification in Key Jurisdictions (Chapter 'France')

heinzWeil.title: Avocat (1986), Rechtsanwalt (1971)
references: Ancien Président du Conseil des Barreaux de l'Union Européenne (CCBE)
heinzWeil.name: Heinz WEIL
heinzWeil.intro: Heinz Weil studied law in Frankfurt and Lyon. After having obtained his qualification as a lawyer and judge in Germany, he moved to France in 1968 where he has been working for five years in a subsidiary of a multinational company. At the age of 30, he became the managing director of this subsidiary.<nl/>Heinz has qualified as a Rechtsanwalt in 1971. In 1974, he left the management in order to found his own law firm in Paris. In 1986, he passed an additional exam to become a French avocat. He is since then member of the Paris Bar.After having been the resident partner of a large German law firm in Paris, he decided to continue developing and expanding his own firm. Thus, his sons Eric and Bruno and his daughter in Law Mathilde joined him to become his partners.<nl/>Heinz concentrates on advice and defence in all main fields of business law: he has been handling major disputes in the field of <blue>industrial risk and hidden defects</blue>, he has advised foreign and French clients in important <blue>M&A transactions</blue> and taken part in major European wide <blue>restructuring of business entities for foreign multinationals</blue>, he has often been appointed as arbitrator or counsel for institutional (ICC type) or ad hoc international arbitrations, and handled cases before the <blue>European Courts</blue>.<nl/>Heinz is fluent in German, French and English. He regularly participates in seminars to initiate foreign lawyers to French business law.<nl/>Heinz has been chosen by his profession to assume important functions: He is a former President of the Council of Bars and Law Societies of Europe (CCBE), he chairs the European Committee of the German Federal Bar, he is a Council member of the International Bar Association (IBA) and he has often served as an expert for the European Commission.<nl/>Heinz Weil has been awarded the Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany and of the Federal Republic of Austria.<nl/>Heinz Weil will participate in the conference organized by the Academy of European Law (ERA) to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Jean Monnet program in Brussels on October 16th, 2019.

whoWeAre.firmPresentation: Founded in 1974, WEIL & ASSOCIES has rapidly earned a reputation for excellence in corporate law on a global scale. <nl/>At the heart of our mission: cutting-edge legal expertise that fosters innovation and growth for our clients, whether they are multinational companies or SMEs. <nl/>Our versatile team is particularly renowned for its responsiveness and attention to detail, ensuring effective representation before courts and arbitral institutions.
whoWeAre.NOUS SOMMES DEDIES A VOTRE SUCCES: WE ARE DEDICATED TO YOUR SUCCESS
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-dedies-a-votre-succes-descri: Since its establishment in 1974 WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies.<nl/>Our firm is devoted to assist companies, international or small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defence of our clients before courts and arbitral tribunals.
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-internationnaux-description: Business relationships of German and English speaking countries have always been a major part of our activity. Therefore, our firm has lawyers admitted at bars in France, Germany and the USA at the same time.<nl/>Our involvement in the advice to and representation of international clients implies that all lawyers write and speak fluently German, French and English.<nl/>In the course of time, our activity conducted us to broaden our horizon and to represent companies from countries such as Japan, Korea and China.
whoWeAre.plus-loin-plus-intelligent-plus-rapide-d: Even though all lawyers are specialised, we believe in an enrichment of the juristic creativity by a large field of experience in legal advice and defence.
whoWeAre.votre-confiance-nous-honore-description: Our work is based on mutual trust with each and every client, international companies as well as small and medium-sized enterprises.<nl/>Each client’s activity, products and professional environment are carefully taken into consideration as our goal is to provide our client with tailor made solutions which take due account of the client’s specific business interests.<nl/>Thanks to the small size of our firm, we compose a team of dynamic lawyers who are acquainted to respond rapidly and with flexibility to the client’s needs.<nl/>We shall never forget that the essence of our work, be it legal advice or advocacy, is to achieve an economically valuable result for our client.
